TABLE.NAME: local_mohh_zone
TABLE.COMMENT: Local normalised copy of the remote zones.

FIELD.NAME: externalid
FIELD.COMMENT: Zipatala zone id. Never used as a Moodle primary key.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Zone name as published remotely.

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional remote description.

FIELD.NAME: active
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 when the zone is no longer published remotely. Rows are deactivated, never deleted.

FIELD.NAME: lastseen
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the last sync run that saw this zone remotely.

TABLE.NAME: local_mohh_district
TABLE.COMMENT: Local normalised copy of the remote districts. Each district belongs to exactly one zone.

FIELD.NAME: externalid
FIELD.COMMENT: Zipatala district id. Never used as a Moodle primary key.

FIELD.NAME: zoneid
FIELD.COMMENT: Local local_mohh_zone.id. Not null, so a district always belongs to exactly one zone.

FIELD.NAME: code
FIELD.COMMENT: Remote district code. Nullable because it is not always published.

KEY.NAME: zoneid
KEY.COMMENT: Foreign key to the zone. Moodle builds the supporting non-unique index on zoneid from this key.

TABLE.NAME: local_mohh_facility
TABLE.COMMENT: Local normalised copy of the remote facilities. Selected fields only; the full remote payload is not stored.

FIELD.NAME: externalid
FIELD.COMMENT: Zipatala facility id. Never used as a Moodle primary key.

FIELD.NAME: districtid
FIELD.COMMENT: Local local_mohh_district.id.

FIELD.NAME: code
FIELD.COMMENT: Zipatala facility code.

FIELD.NAME: codedhis2
FIELD.COMMENT: DHIS2 code from facility_code_mapping.

FIELD.NAME: codeopenlmis
FIELD.COMMENT: OpenLMIS code from facility_code_mapping.

FIELD.NAME: facilitytypeid
FIELD.COMMENT: Remote facility type id. Reference data, not a Moodle id.

FIELD.NAME: ownerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Remote facility owner id. This is NOT a Moodle user id.

FIELD.NAME: operationalstatusid
FIELD.COMMENT: Remote operational status id.

FIELD.NAME: regulatorystatusid
FIELD.COMMENT: Remote regulatory status id.

FIELD.NAME: dateopened
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp, or null when the remote value is absent or unparseable.

FIELD.NAME: publishedat
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp, or null.

FIELD.NAME: remotecreatedat
FIELD.COMMENT: Remote created_at as a Unix timestamp, or null.

FIELD.NAME: remoteupdatedat
FIELD.COMMENT: Remote updated_at as a Unix timestamp, or null. Used to skip unchanged rows.

FIELD.NAME: codemappingjson
FIELD.COMMENT: facility_code_mapping re-encoded as validated JSON. Only this sub-document is retained, because its keys vary by integration and cannot be columnised.

KEY.NAME: districtid
KEY.COMMENT: Foreign key to the district. Moodle builds the supporting non-unique index on districtid from this key.

TABLE.NAME: local_mohh_assign
TABLE.COMMENT: Canonical hierarchy assignment for a Moodle user. A user with no hierarchy has no row here; absence is valid.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user.id. At most one row per user.

FIELD.NAME: zoneid
FIELD.COMMENT: Derived from facilityid. Denormalised for scope queries and kept consistent by the repository.

FIELD.NAME: districtid
FIELD.COMMENT: Derived from facilityid.

FIELD.NAME: facilityid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user's facility. Mirrored into the profilefield_mohhierarchy field value.

FIELD.NAME: scopelevel
FIELD.COMMENT: One of none, facility, district, zone. Validated by local_mohhierarchy\local\scope_level.

FIELD.NAME: assignedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user.id of the actor, or null for migration and automated repair.

FIELD.NAME: assignsource
FIELD.COMMENT: One of userform, admin, migration, repair, cli. Validated by local_mohhierarchy\local\assign_source.

FIELD.NAME: active
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 when the assignment has been withdrawn. The row is retained for audit.

KEY.NAME: userid
KEY.COMMENT: One assignment per user. Moodle builds the unique index on userid from this key.

TABLE.NAME: local_mohh_assignlog
TABLE.COMMENT: Append-only history of assignment changes. Rows are never updated or automatically deleted.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user.id the assignment belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: assignmentid
FIELD.COMMENT: local_mohh_assign.id. Nullable and deliberately not a foreign key, so history outlives the assignment row.

FIELD.NAME: action
FIELD.COMMENT: One of created, updated, deactivated, repaired. Validated by local_mohhierarchy\local\assign_action.

FIELD.NAME: olddata
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON snapshot before the change, or null for a creation.

FIELD.NAME: newdata
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON snapshot after the change, or null for a removal.

FIELD.NAME: changedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user.id of the actor, or null for automated changes.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: One of running, success, failed. Validated by local_mohhierarchy\local\sync_status.

FIELD.NAME: triggerkind
FIELD.COMMENT: One of scheduled, manual, cli. Validated by local_mohhierarchy\local\sync_trigger.

FIELD.NAME: triggeredby
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user.id for manual runs, null for scheduled and CLI runs.

FIELD.NAME: finishedat
FIELD.COMMENT: Null while the run is still in progress.
